exampleEn: Everyone needs to pitch in to complete the project on time.
exampleKo: 모두가 제시간에 프로젝트를 마치기 위해 도움을 줘야 해.
gameExamples: If we all pitch in, we can clean the park in no time.
To make the event a success, everyone should pitch in with ideas and resources.
When you're part of a team, it's important to pitch in whenever you can.
